title: RBI Imposes Penalties on Three NBFCs for KYC and Fair Practice Code Violations
description: <cite index="53-2">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹5.40 lakh on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of the RBI (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions and the directions issued by RBI on Fair Practice Code.</cite> <cite index="53-6">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of Rs2.70 lakh on Namdev Finvest for non-compliance with certain provisions of the RBI (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions.</cite>
